# MoxyArt Studio

> MoxyArt Studio helps local restaurants, shops, and service businesses get found, answer inquiries, and turn interest into bookings. You approve before anything goes live.

MoxyArt Studio offers AI-built websites, GEO and Google presence, an AI receptionist, AI automations, AI ads and commercials, and AI lead finding.

## Services

- AI-built websites
- GEO and Google presence
- AI receptionist
- AI automations
- AI ads and commercials
- AI lead finding
